<column gap="tiny">

**Archetype** [Werecreature](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=225)

**Prerequisites**
[Werecreature Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5486)

---

The eyes and noses of animals are naturally sharper than most humanoids. While in your hybrid or animal shape, you gain [low-light vision](/Rules.aspx?ID=416) and [imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412) [scent](/Rules.aspx?ID=417) with a range of 30 feet.
